description.value: Gatzke Orchard is a four-generation family farm and fruit stand situated on the isthmus between Kalamalka and Wood Lakes in Oyama, operating each season with fresh cherries, raspberries, berries, house-made pies baked from a 1941 Grandma Gatzke recipe, and a range of locally-made value-added products. The farm also hosts Pedego Electric Bikes as a partner operation, positioning it as a natural hub for cyclists riding the Okanagan Valley Rail Trail. A wood-fired pizzeria (Pane Vino) operates on the property, making it a well-rounded stop for touring cyclists seeking fresh local food.
